name: Yamaha FJR1300
engine: 1298 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's sport tourer. Several recalls over the years, including a second gear recall on 2016-2020 bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2006-2009 bikes are in recalls 09V002 (ignition switch) and 11V338 (ground wire junction). Some 2011 bikes are in recall 11V340 (brake light switch). 2013-2020 bikes are in recall 20V814 (brake light switch). 2016-2020 bikes are in recall 20V813 (second gear can break). Some 2016-2021 bikes are in recall 21V865 (ECU).
A-002.reason: Some of these carry a do-not-ride warning until fixed. Every fix is free.

recalls.fix: Dealer fits a new front brake switch free.

recalls.what: Front brake light switch may fail, so the brake light may not come on.
Second gear may crack and break under high-speed load.
recalls.fix: Dealer reprograms the ECU and replaces the main and drive axles free.

recalls.what: ECU software problem. NHTSA lists a do-not-ride advisory.
